correctness.rationale: The rotation coding uses the irrational frequency of symbol 1 and the standard Sturmian factor language. Any phase at a shared endpoint has the trace of the same-sided neighboring cell by the uniform half-open convention. A last queried 1 disallows truncation at any queried position. For pairs, 00 and 10 are available using nonempty short factors, distinct proper translates give 01, and 11 is exactly the arc-overlap test. Below 1/2 this means a strict circular gap less than α, and density ensures some such gap. On A_k at small slope, the two equal short arcs cut only end-anchored intervals: nested intervals omit a mixed pattern, and opposite ends cannot have both overlap and a gap. Thus no triple is shattered. Above 1/2 all pairs shatter; the four triple traces ending in 0 follow by truncation after witnesses for pair traces on the first two queried positions, and the four ending in 1 are exactly the four stated interior tests. Two short complementary arcs of length β=1−α can overlap with arbitrarily small positive displacement ε<min(β,α−β). A later complementary arc fits in the remaining length α−ε>β while leaving some open uncovered space, giving all four interiors. No quadruple can have all eight traces ending in 1: on its final one-arc the three earlier indicators have at most six discontinuities and seven open cells. Heredity covers larger supports. The empty support and singletons have witnesses. Irrational equidistribution gives the unweighted gap indicator mean 2α at small slope, and summing its partial sums gives the stated weighted limit; every large-slope pair counts. Direct evaluation of the eight golden-slope witnesses gave all eight patterns. The inspected rational checker was not run and is only finite corroboration; its length-zero mask duplicates the mask of a nonempty factor consisting of a single zero.

value.rationale: This sharpens a natural exact dimension question left by the established fixed-window theorem and general one-unit bound. It explains concretely why zero padding makes the frequency of the distinguished symbol matter even though fixed-mask dimension is invariant under complementing symbols. The all-support rule gives more than the integer dimension and makes the pair-density observable computable. The claim is specific to Sturmian languages, not a new general dimension theory.
